    M = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    adj = [[] for _ in range(N + 1)]

        u = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        v = int(data[idx]); idx += 1

        adj[u].append((v, w))
        adj[v].append((u, w))
    
    setrecursionlimit(10000)

    visited = [False] * (N + 1)

                visited[nxt] = False
    
    dfs(1, 0)
    print(best[0])
